prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1243; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?

A: I was driving through an intersection in Conroe, Texas, heading toward the shopping center on the main road.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I had just slowed down because the light turned yellow. I was going maybe fifteen miles an hour, and the other car came into my lane.

Q: Was your vehicle moving when the impact happened?

A: Yes, it was moving slowly. The front of the other car hit the front of mine. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to push my car back a little.

Q: Did either airbag deploy?

A: No, they didn't. I didn't hit my head on anything.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, and my lower back aches when I sit too long. I went to the clinic the same afternoon and they told me it looks like a strain.

Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?

A: Yes, I'm doing physical therapy twice a week and taking over-the-counter pain medication when I need it.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was wearing my seatbelt and I'm willing to provide my medical records once you need them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
